thread:
mira: :wave: Hi — accepted the GitHub invite but I'm only listed as an "Outside collaborator" and can't see internal repos. Invite was to my alias mira+work@gmail.com. Did I accept with the wrong account? Who should I ping?

sam: Hey @mira — welcome! First check which email the invite was sent to in the invite email. If it was to your alias you might have accepted with a different GH account. Can you paste the exact invite email address (no need to paste the invite link)?

mira: It's mira+work@gmail.com

jordan: If the org sent it to mira@redwood.com and you accepted with mira+work@gmail.com that will make you an outside collaborator. Two quick fixes:
- sign out and accept the invite while logged into the GH account that matches the invite email
- OR ask people-ops to resend the invite to the account you want to use.

sam: Also check SSO/2FA: if you haven't completed SAML SSO you'll see limited access. Steps:
1) Go to https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference
2) Click "Accept SSO" at the top
3) If prompted, complete 2FA

dev-onboard-bot: Heads up — if you have multiple GitHub accounts, prefer the one bound to your work email. See onboarding doc: https://intranet.redwood/internally/onboarding/github

mira: Tried signing out and re-accepting in incognito. Still shows "Outside collaborator". When I run `gh api user` I get my mira+work account. Not sure how to switch the invite target.

jordan: Okay, reply to this thread with the email the invite showed, and I'll ask people-ops to revoke and resend to mira+work@gmail.com or to add mira+work as a member. If you want to keep mira@redwood.com as your org account we can help transfer access (we'll need to merge/claim). Short term we can add you to the repo as a direct member.

mira: Thanks — prefer to use my mira@redwood.com. If it's easier, can people-ops revoke and resend? I'm around for a quick call if helpful.

sam: @people-ops can you revoke the pending invite and resend to mira@redwood.com? If they confirm 2FA/SAML we can switch them to full member.

dev-onboard-bot: Reminder: enable 2FA (TOTP or YubiKey) to complete SSO. If you run into stubborn alias issues, we can escalate to org-admins.

mira: Will wait for people-ops. Thanks all :thumbsup:
